protocol: Kiro Supervised. Kiro may run read-only git (log/status/diff); C runs every mutating git, AWS and docker command. Edit/create ONLY the 10 files listed, with the IDE write tool. context.design: Each banner is a CSS BACKGROUND image on the page heading; the title text sits on the left. Never inline the SVGs: all four reuse ids 'glow'/'rule' and would collide in one DOM. .content (App.css) is the centre-column scroll container, so position: sticky; top: 0 locks the Home/Notifications/People heading while the feed scrolls. The Messages heading is already locked (only .message_group_feed_collection scrolls) — it just gets its banner. Profile is intentionally unchanged (ActivityFeed without the banner prop renders exactly as before).
context.z_index: Sticky heading z-index 3 sits above the compose form's positioned select (z 1-2). .popup_form_wrap (reply / edit-profile popups) is raised to z-index 1000 so popups stay above the header.
context.sizing: background-size: auto 100% (height-fit, right-anchored): the SVG's purple bottom rule stays visible and its black base continues seamlessly into background-color #000 on the left. Messages column is narrower (~380px): auto 85% + right bottom keeps the artwork clear of the 'Messages' title.
context.tested_by_claude: Rendered in Chromium with these exact CSS rules: all four headings stay pinned after scrolling 300px; title readable; icons visible at 600px, at 420px and in the 380px Messages column; posts never show through. JSX files pass a syntax parse. Not run in the real app — that is the post-deploy verify.
